description: TaskPilot agent eval — 22 tasks. expected_tools = tools the agent should use at least once (tool-selection accuracy). success = LLM-judged on whether the final answer accomplishes the task. requires_approval tasks exercise the human-approval gate (auto-approved by the harness).
